job.job_title: Sr Eng, Soft Engineer Lead - [Angular, AWS,CI/CD,Kubernetes, AI/LLM]
job.job_description:
About the Role

We are looking for a talented Senior Software Engineer to join our team and contribute to the development of scalable, cloud-native, and high-performance applications. The ideal candidate will bring expertise across modern frontend development, cloud technologies, containerization, DevOps practices, security, and AI-assisted software engineering.

This role offers an opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and contribute to the delivery of innovative enterprise solutions.

Required Qualifications
4+ years of overall software development experience.
Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience in Angular development.
Strong experience building modern web applications and enterprise-scale solutions.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Mandatory Technical Skills

Frontend Development: Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript

Containerization & Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes

Cloud Technologies (AWS): EC2, S3, IAM, Lambda, EFS

CI/CD & DevOps: Harness, GitHub Actions, Jenkins

Security & Vulnerability Management: Qualys, Contrast, Prisma, or equivalent tools

Project Management & Collaboration: Jira

AI-Assisted Development: LLMs, RAG, Embeddings, AI Agents, Prompt Engineering

Preferred Technical Skills

Backend Development: Node.js

Content Management Systems: Tridion, Contentstack, or similar platforms

API Management: Apigee or equivalent API Gateway solutions

Content Delivery Network (CDN): Akamai or similar technologies

Database Technologies: Oracle, PostgreSQL

Monitoring & Observability: New Relic, Splunk, or equivalent platforms

Test Automation: Playwright

Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performing applications.
Build and support cloud-native solutions using AWS services.
Develop and manage containerized applications with Docker and Kubernetes.
Implement and optimize CI/CD pipelines to enable efficient software delivery.
Ensure application security, reliability, and operational excellence.
Leverage AI-assisted development tools and practices to improve productivity and innovation.
Collaborate with Product, Architecture, QA, and DevOps teams to deliver business-critical solutions.
Participate in technical design discussions, code reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical challenges across the application lifecycle.
What Were Looking For

We are seeking a technology professional with a passion for engineering excellence, a strong learning mindset, and the ability to thrive in a collaborative environment. The ideal candidate combines expertise in modern application development, cloud technologies, DevOps practices, and emerging AI capabilities to deliver impactful solutions.

Note:

Experience with Angular, AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Security/Vulnerability Management, and AI-assisted development technologies is essential for success in this role.

Qualifications & Experience

Education: Undergraduate studies in computer science, management information systems, or other related degree. Technology experience or non-traditional technology certificates can be substituted for an undergraduate degree.

Experience: Two or more years of analysis and technology experience.

Technical Skills
Business Requirements
CI/CD
Cloud Computing
Programming Languages
Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
Software Engineering
Software Testing
Systems Integration
Soft Skills & Attributes
Strong communication and collaboration skills
Analytical and problem-solving mindset
Ability to work in agile and global environments
Time management and prioritization
